description: Carlos Mantilla and Yolanda Lechon at CIEMAT publish the TIMES-Sinergia input and result collection for Man0EUvRE Case Study 1. The native description names both input and output datasets. Zenodo lists seven XLSX files: results in an EnVis-scenario workbook, raw electricity-production results, four named scenario-input workbooks and a GENeSYS-MOD to TIMES-Sinergia dictionary. These descriptors establish an energy-planning model bundle without exposing the values or workbook structures. The package is freely accessible under CC BY 4.0. Related European Energy Vision scenarios provide the named project context, but exact model years, country coverage, units and time steps are not stated in this deposit’s short metadata. A limitation is that file names cannot establish parameter completeness or successful conversion between the models. No workbook, model code or numerical result was downloaded or executed.
